description.narrative:
Project level impact: Economy wide effects: The Project is expected to generate not only direct jobs from Anyous planned feed mills in 4 frontier provinces, but also indirect jobs along the animal feed value chain, due to the Projects derived demand for raw material sourcing and ambient support services. StakeholdersFarmers: At the current annual production level of 2 million tons of animal feeds, Anyou procures raw materials (mainly grains) indirectly from about 72,000 crop farmers through the corporate suppliers. The Project will increase the procurement of such raw materials, hence enhance crop farmers income accordingly.
Market level impact: Sustainability and Competitiveness: The Project is expected to have a demonstration effect of improving the sustainability and competitiveness of the pig sector, as the use of antibiotic-free and eco-friendly feeds will reduce greenhouse gas footprint, contributing to sustainability of the pig value chain in a cost competitive manner.

The proposed IFC investment consists of a long-term loan of up to CNY260 million (approximately US$40 million equivalent) to Anyou Biotechnology Group Co., Ltd. (Anyou or the Company). Headquartered in Taicang city of Jiangsu province, the Company is an existing IFC client in good standing and a leading animal feed producer in China. The Project entails expanding the Companys eco-friendly and antibiotic-free feed (Eco-feed) capacity by 910,000 tons per annum in frontier regions in China (Guizhou, Gansu, Yunnan), and Hubei province.
